fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-09-16, the complainant found that the main gate near Kalai Colony Apartment Complex had been damaged overnight, causing a loss of roughly Rs. 3,00,000. The time of the incident was given as 02:35 on 2025-09-16. The complaint was lodged by Bharath Gopal (9000000314). Nithin Thangaraj (9000000252) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Siva Selvam, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000440. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned photographs and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, apartment complex, photograph, associate, witness, witness statement, night
